notes.text: An adventure, not a shooter: every input point is a still with 2-7 CHOICE buttons. A choice sets g[0] to a scene code and LinkTailPGC; the region PGC's POST either leaves the region (JumpVTS_PTT) or calls the VMGM dispatcher (PGC 4), whose PRE sends g[0] to the scene. No rnd.
notes.why: So a 'shot model' does not apply; the disc is mapped as a choice graph (tools/choice_graph.py) and played by route scripts.

notes.text: Power-on is an attract loop: VMGM 23 (5 s logo) -> 8 (4 s) -> 9 (31 s) -> 10, whose cell commands loop back to 9 unless a button is pressed.
notes.why: nav_offline's trace_nav park rule never parks in a two-PGC loop; choice_graph uses Player.run(park_on_buttons=True).

notes.text: Choice-graph states include all 16 GPRMs: inventory and progress live there, so one scene with different items is a different node. The VMGM options/title menus alone account for many states.
notes.why: Keep the graph honest about game state; cap with --max-nodes.

notes.text: Choice graph (2026-10-23): 214 input locations; with --state-regs 1,2,3,5,6,7,13 and --per-loc 12 the novelty-first search completes (2142 states, deepest 43 presses). Every region VTS 1-9, 11 is reachable; the route into VTS 8 is 30 presses.
notes.why: Plain breadth-first over all 16 registers never converged: the VMGM inventory/option screens alone made 5000+ states.

notes.text: to_vts8 PASS on dev-cellcmdhold12 (2026-10-23): all 30 steps of the offline route taken on the rig.
notes.why: Evidence that the offline choice graph matches the real core across the whole adventure.

notes.text: Cell 8 (the Guild Hall/Outskirts still) is the last picture of cell 7's clip held: the alignment cannot tell them apart, so glendoe_clip checks 6 -> 7 on screen and reaches cell 8 through the FIFO.
notes.why: A 7 -> 8 screen_sequence would fail on identical pictures, not on playback.

explore.description: Start the disc and walk its default path for 5 minutes (explore); then tools/hil_disc.py explored <run dir>

into_vts2.description: Replay the model's shortest route from power-on into the first region (VTS 2): six presses through the attract loop, the main menu (one Up to b1) and VTS 1. Proves the offline choice graph matches the rig.

to_vts8.description: Replay the model's route from power-on through every region into the last one (VTS 8): 30 presses, via VTS 2-7. Proves the offline choice graph holds across the whole adventure.

glendoe_clip.description: The first travelling-spell decision (crystal ball, VTS 2 PGC 1 cell 6, still 255; b1 = Village of Glendoe): after the press, cell 7 (17.87 s clip, PTS restart, no buttons) must play on screen before cell 8's choice. Maintainer report 2026-10-25: the clip does not show.
